name: Synchronoscope
summary: A synchronoscope indicates the phase relationship and relative frequency behaviour of two AC sources.
description: A synchronoscope indicates the phase relationship and relative frequency behaviour of two AC sources. Its input connections identify which source is incoming and which is the reference.
readingNotes: Trace both source inputs and their selected voltage phases.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A synchronoscope provides indication; a synchronism-check relay provides a configured permissive output.
